# OB.1 AI Solutions

> The AI governance firm for small and mid-market companies. Rules Before Tools: OB.1 scores your AI readiness, writes your governance blueprint, and then stays to run it.

OB.1 AI Solutions helps executives govern AI adoption: CEO, COO, General Counsel, CISO. Law firms come first, then health care and professional services. Manufacturing engagements stand as proof of method. The path in is simple. Take the free 60-second Snapshot. Continue to the full AI Readiness Score, 0 to 100 across six dimensions. Then book the Operational Blueprint, a two-week engagement. It delivers a scored baseline, stakeholder evidence, and a roadmap your board can act on. The product ladder is Diagnostic, Blueprint, Architect, Govern. Governance as a Service runs the controls after the Blueprint: policy management, runtime monitoring, escalation design, compliance alignment, and quarterly reports a board can cite. Outside AI regulations counsel reviews every industry rubric. OB.1 designs and governs. Vetted partners build, so we sell no build hours and our advice stays neutral. Plenty of firms will score your AI readiness and leave. OB.1 stays. Based in Northeast Ohio, serving the United States.
